command_line:
set -eu
Rscript - <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
inputs <- list(
  `97` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544887/inputs/dataset_3befb64c-2dc2-42e8-bb42-5da6503eb574.dat",
  `98` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544887/inputs/dataset_3704146e-14f7-44cd-9fa6-256d0d887343.dat",
  `99` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544887/inputs/dataset_a7c411e0-9d0a-4d64-b0a2-4034e50f92f8.dat"
)
lfc_cutoff <- 1.5
write_gene_list <- function(path, genes) {
  con <- file(path, open = "wt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  writeLines("gene_id", con)
  if (length(genes) > 0) writeLines(genes, con)
}
results <- lapply(inputs, function(path) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  df
})
sets <- lapply(results, function(df) sort(unique(df$gene_id)))
background <- sets[[1]]
for (nm in names(sets)) {
  if (!identical(background, sets[[nm]])) {
    stop(sprintf("RDS gene-id sets differ for strain %s", nm))
  }
}
write_gene_list("background.tsv", background)
summary_rows <- data.frame(strain=character(), direction=character(), foreground_n=integer(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
for (nm in names(results)) {
  df <- results[[nm]]
  up <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff]
  down <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff]
  write_gene_list(sprintf("up%s.tsv", nm), sort(unique(up)))
  write_gene_list(sprintf("down%s.tsv", nm), sort(unique(down)))
  summary_rows <- rbind(summary_rows,
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="up", foreground_n=length(unique(up))),
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="down", foreground_n=length(unique(down))))
}
write.table(summary_rows, file="foreground_summary.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RS
